I find it crazy that I’ve been alive longer after 9/11 than before 9/11. How has it been NINETEEN years?!😩 I was a 16 (almost 17) year-old kid, who swore she was grown. I’ll never forget that vibrant blue cloudless sky as I walked to school that Tuesday morning. #NeverForget

I swore to one day return to my first love. When 9/11 happened, I was a junior in high school. I remember walking into my study hall and on TV was the image of the buildings under attack. At first I thought it was a movie but my teacher assured us that it was not.

As an 8-year-old child I used to think they were residential buildings and always dreamed of having an apartment in one of the towers someday. When my family moved to PA in 1995, I was devastated. I didn’t want to leave my friends behind, and I did NOT want to leave New York!

I couldn’t believe what I was seeing. My heart shattered, and it hasn’t been whole since. I know there was an attack in DC, and the flight that went down here in PA, but the one that stands out in my memory the most, is that of the Twin Towers.
